facts: Parties: Rothley Medical Ltd (Buyer), Thornbury Retail Group plc (Seller); the Company is Corrib Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 22 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 24 September 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 36 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 22 August 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Northgate Robotics Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $450,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Penrith Engineering Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 4 January 2027.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.
